title: 自适应功率均值策略优化提升大模型推理能力
summary: 提出APMPO方法，包含功率均值策略优化(PMPO)和反馈自适应裁剪(FAC)，解决RLVR中静态策略与模型推理能力演化不匹配的问题。在9个数据集上平均Pass@1提升3.0分，优于GRPO等基线。
summary_en: Proposes APMPO with Power-Mean Policy Optimization and Feedback-Adaptive Clipping to address static policy misalignment in RLVR. Achieves 3.0 average Pass@1 improvement over GRPO on 9 math reasoning datasets.
